Snippet AI app is an innovative Share Extension that uses advanced AI technology to enhance your reading experience. With this app, you can enjoy summaries, bullet points, and translations of articles or any written content that you come across. It also helps you remove unwanted clutter from your reading, providing a streamlined and focused experience.

Whether you're a student, a professional, or someone who loves to read, the Snippet AI Reader app is perfect for anyone who wants to improve their reading skills and productivity. With its intuitive interface and powerful AI algorithms, the Snippet AI app is a must-have tool for anyone who values reading and knowledge.

Download the Snippet AIr app today and start experiencing the benefits of enhanced reading!

quotes.text:
Hey HN, check out Snippet AI - the ultimate article companion for Safari users on iOS. Our app removes ads from articles, summarizes or bullet points and offers quick explanations for any paragraph you don't understand. Snippet AI also offers translations.

We're excited about our summarization and bullet pointing features, which are powered by GPT technology. With this, you can quickly and easily get a condensed version of an article that's easy to read and understand.

If you're looking for a simpler, more efficient way to read articles from Safari, give Snippet AI a try. We'd love to hear your feedback on our app. Download it at the link below and let us know what you think. Thanks for checking us out!

Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/snippet-ai-reader-copilot/id1669938719

I will be in the comments to answer and questions you might have.
